brief: A PLA L-bracket 40 mm wide, made of 5 mm thick plate. The base leg is 50 mm long and lies flat; the upright leg stands on the back end of the base and is 40 mm tall overall. Two 5 mm holes pass through the base, 20 mm apart across its width, centred 25 mm from the front end. Two 5 mm holes pass through the upright, 20 mm apart across its width, centred 25 mm above the bottom. It carries no load, so there is no load case.

note: Run 20261008T105449. The record carried the base leg twice -- `length` 50 and `base_leg_length` 50; the design sized the base by `length` and wrote `base_leg_length` into the upright, which Forge rebuilt as wide as the base, so `base_leg_length` drove nothing, and the run ended with no part.
